en.title: The Lost Soul of the Star Chart and the Broken Sword Bookmark
en.premise: A book containing an old celestial map is brought into the used bookstore "Stardust Books." The map depicts stars in a strange arrangement, clearly different from the actual night sky. Tucked between the pages is a small, silver-gleaming brass bookmark in the shape of a broken sword. Is this a cipher left intentionally by someone? As I unravel the mystery of the stars and the bookmark, I begin to search for the fragments of gentle memories sleeping within the town.

zh.title: 星图的迷路者与折断之剑的书签
zh.premise: 旧书店“星屑之书架”收到了一本夹着古老天体图的书。图中描绘的星辰排列奇特，与真实的夜空截然不同。此外，书页间还夹着一枚闪烁银光的、形如“折断之剑”的小黄铜书签。这难道是谁刻意留下的暗号吗？在解开星图排列与书签之谜的同时，我开始寻找沉睡在街道上的温柔记忆碎片。
